solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Meal — father tucks into what's left

indicators.note: tucks into says the word for father is pushed inside the word for what remains

parts.note: the rest is what is left over
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A dad squeezes himself into the leftovers to make a meal of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A repast is a formal or literary word for a meal.

clue.text: Whistler expert to restore front

parts.note: a referee blows a whistle, so a ref is a whistler
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: The painter Whistler, a skilled restorer, renews a facade.
explanation.walkthrough: Whistler looks like the American painter, but it is the referee with his whistle.
explanation.definitionFit: To reface a building is to give it a new front surface.

clue.text: Some send backing for employee not fully occupied

parts.note: part means some, a portion

indicators.note: backing says the word for send is read from the end to the start

parts.note: to remit is to send, as with payment

explanation.surface: Some staff send support for a worker who is under-employed.
explanation.definitionFit: A part-time worker is employed for only some of the hours of a full working week.

clue.text: Small trace of injury apparently bright red

parts.note: a scar is the mark left by an injury
the suffix -let marks something small, as in booklet or piglet

explanation.surface: A slight mark from a wound appears vividly red.
explanation.walkthrough: 'apparently' signals the jokey invented word: a scarlet would be a little scar.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet is a brilliant shade of red.

clue.text: One who achieves goal installing central heating that's very hot

indicators.note: installing says the heating abbreviation is fitted inside the goal-getter

parts.note: a scorer is a player who scores a goal
CH is the standard abbreviation for central heating, as in estate agents' listings

explanation.surface: A footballer who scores has central heating put in, and it is sweltering.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorcher is an informal name for an extremely hot day or thing.

clue.text: Seek to ingratiate, getting left out of the Taste of India

indicators.note: out of says the abbreviation for left is taken away from the phrase

parts.note: curry flavour is the taste of India's best-known dish

explanation.surface: Someone tries to win favour after being excluded from an Indian restaurant called The Taste of India.
explanation.definitionFit: To curry favour is an idiom for trying to win someone's approval by flattery.

clue.text: Run a bottomless fiddle in foreign food

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

indicators.note: bottomless means the last letter of the instrument word, at its foot in a down entry, is lost

parts.note: a fiddle is a violin

explanation.surface: Running a crooked scam that has no limit, involving imported food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddle' suggests a swindle, but it is the violin.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli are Italian filled pasta parcels, a foreign dish to the British setter.

clue.text: Actor missing start of tribute

indicators.note: missing start of says the word for tribute loses its opening letter

parts.note: thanks are an expression of tribute or gratitude

explanation.surface: A performer left out of the opening of a tribute.
explanation.walkthrough: Tom Hanks is the American film actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Tom Hanks is a famous Hollywood actor, here an example of the class.

clue.text: Wine that is put in right cocktail

indicators.note: put in says the abbreviation for that is goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: a sling is a cocktail, as in the Singapore Sling
ie (id est) is the abbreviation for that is

explanation.surface: Wine that is added to the correct mixed drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Riesling is a white wine made from the grape of the same name.

clue.text: In favour of dull style

parts.note: for means in favour of, as in 'all those for'
mat (also matt) means dull, not glossy

explanation.surface: Someone backs a dull way of doing things.
explanation.definitionFit: A format is the layout or style in which something is presented.

clue.text: Department for the Business Secretary?

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
Vince Cable was the UK Business Secretary when this puzzle appeared in 2013

explanation.surface: A question about which government ministry the Business Secretary runs.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a Whitehall ministry; the question mark flags that the minister is identified by first name.
explanation.definitionFit: A province is an administrative region, like a French department.

clue.text: Jazz fan plays around taking Ecstasy producing trance-like state

parts.note: cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast

indicators.note: taking says the drug's letter is taken in among the rearranged letters
around says the letters of plays are moved about

parts.note: E is the usual abbreviation for the drug Ecstasy

explanation.surface: A jazz lover messes about on drugs and ends up in a stupor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jazz fan' looks like a description of the person, but it is the slang word for a jazz lover.
explanation.definitionFit: Catalepsy is a medical condition of rigid, trance-like unresponsiveness.

clue.text: A breeze in part of Genoa perhaps

definitions.meaning: a breeze is something very easy
Genoa is a fruit cake, so a slice of it is a portion of cake

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means something very easy, and literally a slice of a Genoa cake.

clue.text: River and lake bird

parts.note: the Ouse is a river in England (there are several)
L is a standard abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: A list of things seen in the countryside: a river, a lake and a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The ousel (ouzel) is an old name for the blackbird or the ring ouzel, a thrush.

clue.text: Incite Mahatma to riot — he's calculating type

indicators.note: to riot says these letters run wild into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An agitator urges Gandhi to start a riot, a calculating move.
explanation.walkthrough: 'calculating type' sounds like a schemer, but here means someone who works with numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who calculates for a living is an expert in numbers and mathematics.

clue.text: Instinctive knowledge being taught

parts.note: in, as in being in a state, means being
in tuition means being taught

explanation.surface: Instinct versus things learned in class.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer split after two letters: 'being taught' is being in tuition.
explanation.definitionFit: Intuition is understanding gained by instinct rather than reasoning.

clue.text: Easier way to produce crop

definitions.meaning: a quicker or easier route or method
a crop is a closely cut hairstyle

explanation.definitionFit: A shortcut is a quicker route, and a short cut is a cropped haircut.

clue.text: Expert investigating our helicopter crashing

indicators.note: crashing says the letters are smashed up and reassembled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A specialist is looking into why our helicopter came down.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is Agatha Christie's Belgian detective, the expert investigator in her novels.
explanation.definitionFit: Christie's famous Belgian sleuth is the archetypal expert detective in crime fiction.

clue.text: Ideal selection of Rameau to pianist

indicators.note: selection of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A perfect choice of pieces from the composer Rameau for a pianist.
explanation.definitionFit: Utopian describes a perfect, idealised state of things.

clue.text: New version left simple vessel

parts.note: red is used for left-wing politics
a raft is a basic boat

explanation.surface: A rewrite leaves behind a plain boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A redraft is a revised, new version of a document.

clue.text: Doc's chum with nothing much happening

definitions.meaning: Doc and ... are two of the Seven Dwarfs in Snow White

explanation.definitionFit: Sleepy is a dwarf alongside Doc, and a sleepy town is a quiet one.

clue.text: Sat on back of pinto for cowboy display

parts.note: rode means sat on, as on a horse

indicators.note: back of selects the final letter of the horse word

explanation.surface: Someone sat astride a piebald horse for a show of cowboy skills.
explanation.definitionFit: A rodeo is a public show of cowboy skills like bronco riding and roping.

clue.text: Exercise baboon

explanation.definitionFit: Drill means practice training, and is also the name of a West African baboon.

clue.text: Anger director going into superfluous detail in safety exercise

indicators.note: going into says these pieces are put inside the decoration word

parts.note: a frill is an unnecessary extra or embellishment
ire is a literary word for anger

explanation.surface: An angry manager fusses over pointless details of a safety practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice evacuation in case of fire is a standard safety exercise in buildings.

clue.text: Villain has border home occupying West Coast state

indicators.note: occupying says these pieces sit inside the state's abbreviation

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, on the US West Coast
a rim is an edge or border
in means at home

explanation.surface: A crook has a house near the frontier in California.
explanation.definitionFit: A villain is a lawbreaker, someone guilty of crime.

clue.text: Married adventurous girl, showing ill will

parts.note: Alice is the girl whose adventures in Wonderland Lewis Carroll told

explanation.surface: A girl with an adventurous spirit gets married and shows spite.
explanation.definitionFit: Malice is the desire to harm others, synonymous with spite.

clue.text: Story book series editor put together with skill

parts.note: a tale is a story
NT, the New Testament, is a series of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: An editor assembles a story from a series of books, skilfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Being gifted means having natural ability or skill.

clue.text: Mean 'like a bee'

definitions.meaning: mean as in miserly, tight with money
having a sting, as a bee does

explanation.definitionFit: Stingy means ungenerous, and read literally it describes something with a sting.
